    AI Overview
    The 2026 NCAA Men's Frozen Four takes place at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas on April 9 and 11, 2026, featuring Wisconsin vs. North Dakota and Michigan vs. Denver. The semifinals are Thursday, April 9, with the championship game on Saturday, April 11, with all games available on ESPN networks. 
    2026 Men's Frozen Four Schedule (All times ET) 
    • Semifinal 1: Wisconsin 2, North Dakota 1
    • Semifinal 2: Michigan vs. Denver – Thursday, April 9, 8:30 p.m. (ESPN2)
    • Championship: Semifinal 1 Winner vs. Semifinal 2 Winner – Saturday, April 11, 5:30 p.m. (ESPN) 
    Event Information 
    • Location: T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas, NV
    • TV Channels: ESPN2 / ESPN
    • Live Stream: FuboTV
